scope: Private host-side replay of the on-device fuel planner against the immutable NS pack; no phone install and no live/server request.
decision: Use 32 as the default discovery cohort. It retains more corridor alternatives than 16 while matching the selected stop and continuation in this real NS pack fixture.
correctness_note: The planner proves each selected station with a profile route and continuation. The strict NativeFuelContinuity audit still reports unverified 26-34 m pump approach geometry and source-walk mismatches; this remains a qualification item and is not being hidden by the speed result.
recovery: Do not install to white from this checkpoint. Rebuild the private probe from the current source and rerun the fixture before any device test.

routeReuse.change: PackRoutingSource returns the already-proven start→pump and pump→destination routes; ItineraryBuilder consumes a complete pack window without issuing a second route search.
routeReuse.qualification: This verifies the client reuse path with a scripted pack source. Real-pack strict NativeFuelContinuity still has the documented pump-approach/source-walk qualification.

currentSourceReplay.scope: Current captured PackRoutingSource replay against the same immutable NS pack; macOS host facade, not phone qualification.
